scope: This gate asks whether the eight-state Q/R/F measurement instrument is usable. It is not a PM passing score and does not require a favorable treatment effect.

fixed_grain.independent_effect_group: one completed current state plus its frozen state-local actual Rank-1 candidate
fixed_grain.generator_replicate: one paired seed with one ON and one OFF response
fixed_grain.quality_item: one blinded ON/OFF replicate comparison, evaluated in both AB and BA order
fixed_grain.risk_item: one response evaluated absolutely before any arm contrast
fixed_grain.function_item: one ON response evaluated against the exact typed candidate
fixed_grain.forbidden_pseudoreplication: reviewer, AB/BA order, and generator replicate never increase the number of independent effect groups

role_separation.quality: positive support contribution only; no risk, function, cost, memory preference, or applicability penalty
role_separation.risk: literal absolute event family and severity for each response; no helpfulness or function score
role_separation.function: literal candidate contribution and realized component-specific act in ON responses; no OFF comparison or quality score
role_separation.cost: provider and injected-context telemetry only; never a component label
role_separation.disagreement: UNRESOLVED; never majority-voted, silently set to zero, or converted to OFF

measurement_usability_gates_not_pm_score.logical_calls_and_schema: 64/64 strict-schema calls with unique reviewer-role-group keys
measurement_usability_gates_not_pm_score.literal_excerpt_validity: 100 percent for every nonempty response, candidate, and evidence excerpt
measurement_usability_gates_not_pm_score.quality_within_reviewer: for each reviewer, at least 70 percent of 24 items resolve in both AB/BA orders and at least 70 percent of those have the same mapped ON/OFF/TIE direction
measurement_usability_gates_not_pm_score.quality_between_reviewers: at least 70 percent of 24 items are order-consistent for both reviewers and raw mapped-direction agreement is at least 70 percent among those items
measurement_usability_gates_not_pm_score.function_between_reviewers: at least 80 percent of 24 ON items are resolved by both reviewers and binary FUNCTIONAL/nonfunctional raw agreement is at least 80 percent among them
measurement_usability_gates_not_pm_score.risk_between_reviewers: at least 80 percent of 48 individual responses are resolved by both reviewers and material-event raw agreement is at least 80 percent among them
measurement_usability_gates_not_pm_score.reason: these are missingness and instrument-repeatability safeguards inherited from the frozen canary preflight, not evidence that the PM has learned

mapping.quality_ab_ba: forward A=ON/B=OFF; reverse A=OFF/B=ON; reverse A-minus-B deltas are sign-inverted before averaging
mapping.quality_tie: TIE requires all four deltas to be zero
mapping.function_binary: FUNCTIONAL versus all resolved nonfunctional statuses; exact five-class agreement is also reported
mapping.risk_material_event: at least one literal event with severity >=2
mapping.risk_critical_event: severity 3 is reported separately and never absorbed into the mean

diagnostics_not_gates.cohen_kappa_and_gwet_ac1: reported for context but never substituted for the predeclared raw-agreement gates
diagnostics_not_gates.treatment_direction_and_magnitude: reported only after this measurement-usability decision and not used to redefine it

three_distinct_decisions.effect_feasibility: after measurement passes, inspect requested-received-used-functional uptake and whether randomized same-state ON/OFF outcomes contain nonconstant, bidirectional learnable variation
three_distinct_decisions.final_pm_pass: only held-out policy behavior decides: compare the learned 16-action policy against always-off, fixed-high, old V1.0, transparent-rule, and cost-matched-fixed baselines on separately reported positive support contribution, material risk, function, and cost

final_pm_pass_rule_freezing.development_only: select clinically or operationally meaningful effect and noninferiority margins once from development-pilot distributions and baseline variability
final_pm_pass_rule_freezing.sealed_evaluation: never tune margins, thresholds, features, models, abstention, or baselines after sealed outcomes are visible
final_pm_pass_rule_freezing.minimum_claim: the learned policy must show useful held-out conditional behavior relative to always-off and at least one scientifically relevant stronger baseline; measurement agreement alone can never pass the PM
final_pm_pass_rule_freezing.component_failure: a head without sufficient held-out support remains fixed OFF and is reported as unsupported rather than forced to pass

decision.measurement_pass: analyze canary uptake/effects and prepare a separately cost-capped remaining-88-state development run
decision.measurement_fail: stop before the remaining 88 states and repair only runner/schema in a new version without changing observed states, candidates, seeds, responses, endpoints, or thresholds
never_authorized: claim that a component is useful
convert unresolved judgments to zero or OFF
run the remaining 88 states without a new frozen cost and execution authorization
